messages:
sophia_csm: Heads up — preparing the QBR for AtlasOps (renewal in 9w). Trying to lock slides + exec asks today. Sharing a first-pass slide list in case folks want to add/flag risks.

mike_am: thanks. can you drop the deck link? I have the latest usage numbers but need the ARR delta.

sophia_csm: deck here: https://redwood-drive/AtlasOps/QBR-1763509876.pptx — section order I propose:
- Exec summary (1 slide)
- Health + onboarding status (1-2 slides)
- Usage & cost trends (1 slide)
- Risks & mitigation (1 slide)
- Ask (contract / exec time / enablement)

ana_cs: onboarding is at ~72% for the new agent flows. Still waiting on SSO cert from their infra team (blocking 1 integration). ETA from them is end of next week.

raj_retail: renewal risk = Medium. They've been OK with performance but called out 95th p99 latency spikes last month. I asked infra for logs — tracking.

tara_enablement: I can own the training slide + exec enablement notes. Will add recommended success metrics for next 90d.

mike_am: added usage chart (monthly tokens by route). Quick note: embeddings consumption dropped 18% last month after they switched to local caching — that's in the deck.

sophia_csm: action items (assignments):
- [sophia_csm] finalize narrative + risk slide by EOD today
- [mike_am] confirm ARR delta + update usage chart by 2pm
- [ana_cs] escalate SSO cert with their infra contact; update timeline by EOD
- [tara_enablement] add enablement ask + proposed runbook for execs by tomorrow
- [raj_retail] provide p99 incident summary + mitigation proposal

ana_cs: ack, I will ping their SRE lead and copy legal for cert requirements.

raj_retail: p99 summary: short blip on 2026-02-18 after a background job change; root cause = unbatched KV cache misses. mitigation: apply prefix caching + bump batch size on Dedicated pool. I'll draft the technical note.

mike_am: confirming ARR numbers: base ARR 420k, expansion pipeline +45k (probable). Marking renewal risk as "monitor" in CRM with note about latency.

sophia_csm: need exec alignment: who can join the 15-min pre-brief with their CFO? ideally our CRO + head of eng. @mike_am can you coordinate? :calendar:

mike_am: yep, I can schedule. proposed slots: Mon 3/30 9:00am PT or Tue 3/31 11:00am PT. picking Mon if execs are free.

tara_enablement: added a one-slide quick-start for the CFO about unit economics + expected cost delta after caching changes.

sophia_csm: cool. final ask: please leave comments on the deck by 5pm. I'll consolidate and create the final PDF for execs tomorrow. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "AtlasOps QBR pre-brief" Mon Mar 30 09:00 PT — invites sent to sophia_csm, mike_am, tara_enablement, raj_retail, ana_cs

mike_am: received. I'll loop in CRO for confirmation.

sophia_csm: thanks everyone — feel free to ping me directly for questions.
